events.name: run_python

args.code:
import os, hashlib, itertools
root='dosyalar'
byhash={}
for dp,dn,fn in os.walk(root):
    for f in fn:
        p=os.path.join(dp,f)
        rel=os.path.relpath(p,root).replace(os.sep,'/')
        with open(p,'rb') as fh:
            h=hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
        byhash.setdefault(h,[]).append(rel)
groups=[sorted(v) for v in byhash.values() if len(v)>=2]
groups.sort(key=lambda g:g[0])
out='\n'.join(' | '.join(g) for g in groups)
print(out)
with open('kopyalar.txt','w',encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    fh.write(out+('\n' if out else ''))
print('---kopyalar.txt---')
print(out)
